blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Police have filed criminal complaints against the motorcycle rider involved in a fatal collision along the Transcentral Highway in Barangay Babag, Cebu City last week, after tests confirmed he was driving under the influence of alcohol. The Traffic Enforcement Unit of the Cebu City Police Office (TEU-CCPO) filed the complaints for reckless imprudence resulting in homicide and damage to property against the driver of a Yamaha Aerox.
